description: Set Client namespace to com.azure.ai.openai for Java
feedback: For Java, the Client namespace should be 'com.azure.ai.openai'.

description: Set Azure.OpenAI service namespace to com.azure.ai.openai for Java
feedback: For Java, the Azure.OpenAI service namespace should be 'com.azure.ai.openai'.

description: Move FileListResponse, OpenAIPageableListOf, and FunctionCallPreset to implementation namespace for Java
